title: Freya and the Songbook
author: Vesper Nystrom
blurb: August Villalobos, a single parent running the town's only bookshop, swears the heart is a muscle like any other: trainable, containable. Then the anonymous pen-pal assignment pairs enemies instead of strangers — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, they must risk the whole heart instead of lending pieces before the bakery lease runs out.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
